data.title: 丛雨 · 把纸边折进菱形
data.description: 和室的矮桌上压着一叠裁齐的素纸。丛雨盘坐在垫子上，用拇指把翘起的折边沿着旧痕压成菱形。纯白棉单衣的交领整齐合拢，宽袖放在桌边，暖阳把手下的折痕照得清清楚楚。
data.action: 盘坐，用双手折好准备悬挂的菱形纸饰
data.lighting: 纸门透进的日光照清手指下的折痕
data.camera: 平视侧面全身坐姿，矮桌在前
data.promptProse: Murasame sits cross-legged by the low table and presses an errant fold into a diamond as morning light crosses the tatami. Her white cotton underkimono is worn fully closed, with the wide sleeves resting at the table edge and a plain cord holding the overlap in place.
data.animaCaption: She presses her thumb along the crease until the raised corner lies flat.
